title: CryptoLab: Bitcoin Price Forecasting
summary: A personal project: a FastAPI backend and web frontend for Bitcoin price forecasting with an LSTM model and Binance market data.
overview: CryptoLab is a cryptocurrency price forecasting tool. The backend fetches data from the Binance API, forecasts Bitcoin prices with an LSTM model, reports market sentiment probabilities and handles contact-form queries by email.
problem: Price history is noisy and hard to interpret by eye. This project fetches market data and applies a sequence model to produce forecasts.
approach: Real-time and historical data are fetched with the Binance API.
An LSTM model forecasts Bitcoin prices from historical data.
Market sentiment probabilities (bullish, bearish, neutral) are provided.
JWT authentication protects the forecasting endpoints; contact queries are sent by SMTP email.

architecture.label: Forecasting
architecture.detail: TensorFlow LSTM model with Pandas and NumPy for data preparation.

workflow.step: Market data is fetched from Binance.
The LSTM model produces a price forecast.
The frontend shows the forecast and sentiment to authenticated users.

items: Built the backend and frontend of this personal project, per the public repositories.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
The backend README states it was in development and not yet deployed as of 5 June 2025. Forecasts are not financial advice.
